newsitem.title: MEXICO: Camesa forecasts 1 bln peso sales in '96.
newsitem.headline: Camesa forecasts 1 bln peso sales in '96.

text.p: Grupo Industrial Camesa, which makes steel cables and operates fluorite mines, forecasted full-year sales of 1 billion pesos and net earnings over 200 million pesos, the group's CFO said on Friday.

"We basically expect the group's sales for the year to be one billion pesos, and earnings should be double last year's level, or more than 200 million pesos," said Camesa's CFO Jose Gonzalez Monroy in a telephone interview.
Camesa may invest in a plant next year to remove impurities from fluourite, Gonzalez said.
"The 1997 (investment budget) has yet to be approved, but if we do invest, it will be in a plant to remove fluourite impurities," he added.
